b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Tisza Regulation
b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.scenario: At a museum exhibition about the Tisza in Szeged, a visitor asks you, the guide, what the 19th-century river regulation changed. You name one result for the river and one for the land.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.prompt: Tell the visitor what the river regulation changed.
cues: Say what happened to the river's bends
Say what happened to the marshes
Say what happened to the groundwater level
b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.target: A kanyarulatok átvágása következtében a Tisza rövidebb lett. A mocsarak lecsapolása nyomán csökkent a talajvízszint.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.english: As a result of cutting through the bends, the Tisza became shorter. In the wake of the draining of the marshes, the groundwater level fell.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-01.canDo: I can recount the history and monumental scale of 19th-century Hungarian river regulation (Széchenyi, Vásárhelyi).

b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Questions about the Dam
b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.scenario: After a lecture in Budapest about the 1980s, a student asks you why many experts opposed the Nagymaros dam. You say how the risks became known and what the experts feared.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.prompt: Tell the student why many experts opposed the dam.
cues: Say how the independent experts proved the risks
Say what the published data made researchers do
Name what the dam endangered in Budapest
b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.target: A szakvélemények révén sokan megismerték a kockázatokat. Az adatok hatására egyre több kutató szólalt fel a vízlépcső ellen, mert veszélyeztette a főváros ivóvízellátását.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.english: Through expert opinions, many people learned about the risks. Under the impact of the data, more and more researchers spoke out against the dam, because it endangered the capital's drinking water supply.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-02.canDo: I can explain the political and ecological background of the Czechoslovak–Hungarian Bős–Nagymaros hydroelectric project.

b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Danube Circle
b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.scenario: At an anniversary talk in Budapest, a guest asks you what the Duna Kör did. You say what the members did to inform people and what happened in September 1988.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.prompt: Tell the guest what the Duna Kör did.
cues: Say what the members did to inform the public
b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.target: A Duna Kör a lakosság tájékoztatása érdekében röplapokat terjesztett. 1988-ban a Duna megmentése érdekében több tízezer ember tüntetett.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.english: In the interest of informing the public, the Duna Kör distributed leaflets. In 1988, in the interest of saving the Danube, tens of thousands of people demonstrated.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-03.canDo: I can narrate the formation of the Duna Kör (1984) and the historic 1988 mass demonstrations in Budapest.

b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Protecting the Waters
b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.scenario: At a talk on water protection in Keszthely, a visitor asks you what was done for the Balaton and the Tisza. You mention the Kis-Balaton and the measures after the cyanide spill.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.prompt: Tell the visitor what was done to protect the waters.
cues: Say what was built to avoid the Balaton's algae
Say what the authorities closed after the spill
b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.target: A katasztrófa elkerülése végett megépítették a Kis-Balaton védőrendszert. A mérgezés megelőzése végett elzárták a holtágak zsilipjeit.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.english: In order to avoid catastrophe, they built the Kis-Balaton protection system. In order to prevent poisoning, they closed the sluices of the oxbow lakes.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-04.canDo: I can explain how Lake Balaton was protected (Kis-Balaton) and what happened after the 2000 Tisza cyanide spill.

b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Drought on the Plain
b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.scenario: At a water-management workshop in Kecskemét, a farmer asks you what is happening on the Homokhát. You say what the drought does and what experts suggest.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.prompt: Tell the farmer about the Homokhát and what experts suggest.
cues: Say what the drought did to the groundwater
Say what experts suggest to replenish it
Mention the purpose of the suggestion
b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.target: Az aszályok következtében a Homokháton csökken a talajvízszint. A talajvíz pótlása érdekében a szakemberek szerint a vizet a tájban kell tartani.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.english: As a result of the droughts, the groundwater level falls on the Homokhát. In order to replenish the groundwater, according to experts, the water must be kept in the landscape.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-05.canDo: I can describe the challenges of drought and water retention on the Great Plain (Alföld).

b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Danube in a Nutshell
b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.scenario: At a Danube exhibition, a visitor asks you for a short story of how Hungarians dealt with their rivers. You mention river regulation, the dam dispute and the Duna Kör.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.prompt: Give the visitor a short account of rivers in Hungarian history.
cues: Say what the river regulation led to
Say what happened under the impact of the data on the dam
b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.target: A folyószabályozás következtében csökkent az árvízveszély. A vízlépcső elleni érvek hatására sok kutató szólalt fel, a Duna megóvása érdekében pedig több tízezer ember tüntetett.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.english: As a result of river regulation, the flood risk fell. Under the impact of the arguments against the dam, many researchers spoke out, and in the interest of protecting the Danube, tens of thousands of people demonstrated.
b2-kornyezetpolitika-consolidation.canDo: I can recount the history of Hungarian river engineering, the 1980s Duna Kör movement, Lake Balaton's preservation, and the 2000 Tisza cyanide spill.
